avis.texte: Love this product. I just wish it wasn't so over priced. I had to switch back to Dr Gross peel pads because get more peel pads for the money.

My dermatologist office recommended this and it really works well. I use it on my back and it helps so much from summer sunscreen breakouts! Really clears clogged pores. I weirdly enjoy the tingle because I feel like that’s how I know it’s working, but if you’re very sensitive, just know it feels like you have peppermint directly on your skin for a little bit (maybe 5 min).

I am 41 and like to get micro needling but can’t always commit to the downtime for recovery. This product works great at making my skin so smooth and more even toned. No skin peeling or redness. I wasn’t sure if it was working since I wasn’t flaking but my makeup looks so smooth all the little bumps on my forehead are gone, I noticed after 2 uses.
Can immediately tell a difference in my skin texture. Expensive, but it works well.

avis.titre: Don’t forget the second step because it is a neutralizer!
avis.texte: I am a very fit 62 year old grandma. I have dry skin and prefer the simplest steps possible. I love the way my skin looks the next day each time I use it! Very glowy. The 2 part system is easy to use. After my face, I use up the cloth on my chest and hands. I don’t want to waste a drop. 5 stars for me.
I use this 2 to 3 times per week. It helps minima my pores and keeps my skin looking bright.

Love this product!! I use it twice a week and it helps with my breakouts so much. Step 1 definitely stings for about 20 seconds or so, so beware. But step 2 feels so soothing and cooling.

avis.titre: Great product and same as used in salon.
avis.texte: This is the best deal for these, I used to go and get my facials done with this product from a salon but I've bought these and saved money. Great brand and my skin feels fantastic.

I love this product! You will 100% feel it working . Great for acne /dark spots 🥰 you are gonna wanna put lotion on after, I wait about 30mins so step 2 can do its job first (Make sure you wear sunscreen everyday!)

I bought this based upon the reviews. As well as carefully reading the add. I was expecting a little tingling but omg. As soon as I wiped my face it felt like it was on fire. Worse than a sunburn. I woke up to peeling of my face. Anything I put on it burns my face. Doesn't matter if it's a rich moisturizer or a face oil. IT all burns my face now. I use a skin grade 1% retinoid but it didn't do my face like this. Definitely don't recommend for sensitive skin. Update. It’s been 8 days since using this product and my face still is red , burnt and patches of scaly cracked skin. I’m praying my face doesn’t scar from this product. It also itches like crazy on top of burning and my skin so tight hurts to open my mouth. Make sure you patch test first. NOT for sensitive skin. It caused an actual chemical burn and allergic reaction. Biggest regret ever! Made appointment with Dermatologist and Plastic Surgeon who advised to use white petroleum jelly on it. Praying that it helps.
This does not make the skin smooth or bright. Maybe good for people new to peels but didn’t do a thing for me
